pnpm.$comment: ONE React for the whole workspace. packages/ui and packages/map declare react as a peer with range '*'; pnpm's auto-install-peers happily satisfied that with a DIFFERENT patch than the one Expo SDK 57 pins, which puts two Reacts in one bundle ('Invalid hook call'). These overrides make the pin structural rather than a convention. Bump them together with the Expo SDK, never alone. react-native-svg is pinned here for the same reason: it ships native code that Expo SDK 57 builds against, and two copies in one bundle is a silent render failure rather than an error. react-native-gesture-handler (G1) is pinned for the same reason: native code, the version Expo SDK 57's bundledNativeModules names (~2.32.0, of which 2.32.0 is the only release). @react-native-community/netinfo is pinned for the same reason: native code, the version Expo SDK 57's bundledNativeModules names (12.0.1).
